title: VPN keeps disconnecting + second monitor
body:
Two things:

1) When I work from home the VPN (GlobalProtect) disconnects roughly every 20 minutes and I have to log in again. It started last Monday. When it drops I lose my Teams call and any unsaved work in the ERP. My home internet is fine otherwise, Netflix/Zoom don't drop.

2) Also, could I get a second monitor for my desk at the office? Working with two spreadsheets side by side on a 14" laptop screen is painful.

Thanks!
